iframe.title: Embedded HTML
iframe.srcdoc:
<!-- Generated by build_singlefile.py; edit index.html instead. -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SuperUser Proxy</title>
  <link rel="icon" id="appFavicon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

    :root {
      --bg: #09090b;
      --bg-panel: #111113;
      --bg-elevated: #18181b;
      --border: #27272a;
      --border-focus: #3f3f46;
      --green: #22c55e;
      --green-glow: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25);
      --green-dark: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1);
      --cyan: #06b6d4;
      --text: #f4f4f5;
      --text-muted: #a1a1aa;
      --text-dim: #71717a;
      --danger: #ef4444;
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-pill: 9999px;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html, body {
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      overflow: hidden;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       CINEMATIC TYPEWRITER + BUMP + RIPPLE INTRO OVERLAY
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #introOverlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: #000000;
      z-index: 9999;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease, visibility 0.4s;
    }

    #introOverlay.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    #rippleCanvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .intro-stage {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 68px);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .intro-prompt {
      color: var(--green);
      margin-right: 14px;
      display: inline-block;
      text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--green-glow);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(-40px);
      transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .intro-prompt.bump-windup {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-65px);
    }

    .intro-prompt.bump-strike {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.2);
    }

    .intro-word {
      color: #ffffff;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    .intro-word.recoil {
      transform: translateX(16px);
    }

    .intro-char {
      display: inline-block;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(4px);
      transition: opacity 0.08s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
    }

    .intro-char.typed {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .intro-char.green {
      color: var(--green);
      text-shadow: 0 0 16px var(--green-glow);
    }

    .intro-cursor {
      color: var(--green);
      display: inline-block;
      margin-left: 4px;
      animation: blink 0.8s step-end infinite;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    @keyframes blink {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0; }
    }

    .intro-skip-hint {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 32px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       APP SHELL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .app-shell {
      display: flex;
      height: 100vh;
      width: 100vw;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       MODERN SIDEBAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .sidebar {
      width: 220px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 16px 12px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      z-index: 20;
      transition: width 0.22s ease, padding 0.22s ease;
    }

    .sidebar.collapsed {
      width: 68px;
      padding-left: 10px;
      padding-right: 10px;
    }

    .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-label,
    .sidebar.collapsed .tab-title,

    .sidebar.collapsed .new-tab-btn span {
      display: none;
    }

    .new-tab-btn b { display: none; }
    .sidebar.collapsed .new-tab-btn b { display: inline; }

    .sidebar.collapsed .tab-item,
    .sidebar.collapsed .search-tabs-control,
    .sidebar.collapsed .new-tab-btn {
      justify-content: center;
      padding-left: 8px;
      padding-right: 8px;
    }

    .sidebar.collapsed .sidebar-actions {
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .sidebar-header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .search-tabs-btn {
      width: 100%;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .search-tabs-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
    }

    .search-tabs-control {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 32px;
      padding: 0 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      background: var(--bg-panel);
    }

    .search-tabs-control input {
      min-width: 0;
      width: 100%;
      border: 0;
      outline: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text);
      font: 11px 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }

    .search-tabs-control input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }


    .tab-list {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      padding-right: 2px;
    }

    .tab-list::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
    .tab-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border); border-radius: 4px; }

    .tab-item {
      width: 100%;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .tab-item[hidden] {
      display: none;
    }

    .tab-item:hover:not(.active) {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
    }

    .tab-item.active {
      background: var(--green);
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: #000000;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .tab-title {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .tab-favicon {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex: 0 0 16px;
      object-fit: contain;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .tab-favicon-fallback {
      width: 16px;
      flex: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .tab-close {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      flex: 0 0 18px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 5px;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 18px;
      opacity: 0.65;
      padding: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
    }

    .tab-close:hover {
      opacity: 1;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    }

    .sidebar-footer {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      padding-top: 8px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .new-tab-btn {
      width: 100%;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px dashed var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .new-tab-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-dark);
    }

    .sidebar-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .sidebar-mini-btn {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .sidebar-mini-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
    }

    .sidebar-icon-btn {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 15px;
    }

    .sidebar-icon-btn:hover {
      color: var(--green);
      border-color: var(--green);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       VIEWPORT
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .viewport {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    .viewport.browsing .terminal-container {
      bottom: calc(100% - 56px);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translate(-50%, -8px) scale(0.96);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       TOP URL BAR (ACTIVE WEBPAGES ONLY — HIDDEN ON NEWTAB)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .top-url-bar {
      height: 48px;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 30;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      animation: slideDown 0.18s ease both;
    }

    .top-url-bar.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* Bookmarks bar */
    .bookmarks-bar {
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 3px 14px;
      background: #0d0d0f;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      height: 30px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      white-space: nowrap;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      z-index: 9;
    }
    .bookmarks-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .top-url-bar.active ~ .bookmarks-bar,
    .viewport.browsing .bookmarks-bar {
      display: flex;
    }
    body.games-fullscreen .bookmarks-bar {
      display: none !important;
    }
    .bm-bar-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      max-width: 170px;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .bm-bar-item:hover {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: var(--border);
    }
    .bm-bar-item img {
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .bm-bar-item span {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .ctx-item:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    }

    /* Games fullscreen: removes top search bar, search button & sidebar */
    body.games-fullscreen .top-url-bar,
    body.games-fullscreen #topUrlBar,
    body.games-fullscreen .sidebar {
      display: none !important;
    }
    body.games-fullscreen .viewport {
      width: 100vw !important;
      height: 100vh !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
    }
    body.games-fullscreen #frameArea,
    body.games-fullscreen .browser-tab-frame.active {
      width: 100vw !important;
      height: 100vh !important;
      position: fixed !important;
      inset: 0 !important;
      z-index: 999999 !important;
    }

    .shortcut-svg {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--text);
    }
    .shortcut-svg svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
    }

    .top-command-autocomplete {
      position: absolute;
      top: 52px;
      left: 140px;
      right: 68px;
      z-index: 80;
    }

    @keyframes slideDown {
      from { transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; }
      to   { transform: translateY(0);     opacity: 1; }
    }

    .top-nav-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .top-nav-btn {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .top-nav-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border-color: var(--border);
    }

    .top-url-input-wrap {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      padding: 0 12px;
      height: 32px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .top-url-input-wrap:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--green);
    }

    .top-url-lock {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    #topUrlInput {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .top-go-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .top-go-btn:hover {
      background: var(--green-dark);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       HOME SCREEN (NEW TAB)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #homeScreen {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 24px 24px 120px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    #homeScreen.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: clamp(42px, 7vw, 76px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--green);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      text-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--green-glow);
    }

    .hero-brand .hero-prompt {
      margin-right: 12px;
      animation: blink 1.2s step-end infinite;
    }

    .hero-meta {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .hero-meta span {
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .system-status {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0 0 26px;
    }

    .status-chip {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(17,17,19,.78);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 7px 10px;
    }

    .status-chip strong {
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .quick-chips {
      width: min(720px, 100%);
    }

    #quickShortcuts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(96px, 112px));
      justify-content: start;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .shortcut-tile {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 10px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font: 12px 'Inter', sans-serif;
      padding: 16px 10px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .shortcut-tile-wrap { position: relative; }

    .shortcut-tile:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .shortcut-icon {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      object-fit: contain;
    }

    .shortcut-glyph {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .shortcut-remove {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 1;
      top: 7px;
      right: 7px;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .shortcut-remove:hover { color: var(--danger); background: rgba(239, 68, 68, .12); }

    .shortcut-add-wrap { position: relative; }

    .shortcut-add-menu {
      position: fixed;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      z-index: 1200;
      width: min(380px, calc(100vw - 32px));
      max-height: min(80vh, 620px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 18px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px #000c;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .shortcut-add-menu[hidden] { display: none; }
    .shortcut-add-menu h3 { margin: 2px 0 12px; color: var(--text); font-size: 16px; }
    .shortcut-add-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      right: 12px;
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .shortcut-add-close:hover { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text); }
    .shortcut-custom-form { display: grid; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 4px 2px; }
    .shortcut-default-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: end; }
    .shortcut-default-form label { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
    .shortcut-default-form select {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      outline: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font: 12px 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .shortcut-custom-form input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      outline: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font: 12px 'Inter', sans-serif;
    }
    .shortcut-custom-form input:focus { border-color: var(--green); }

    .search-provider {
      position: relative;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 0 7px;
    }

    .search-provider-trigger {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .search-provider-trigger:hover,
    .search-provider.open .search-provider-trigger { background: var(--bg-elevated); }

    .search-provider-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 10px);
      left: 0;
      z-index: 50;
      width: 180px;
      padding: 5px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px #0009;
    }

    .search-provider-menu[hidden] { display: none; }

    .search-provider-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 7px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .search-provider-option:hover,
    .search-provider-option[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--text); }

    .search-provider-icon {
      display: inline-grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 22px;
      height: 22px;
      flex: 0 0 22px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--green);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .wisp-finding-screen {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: #000000;
      z-index: 99998;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      text-align: center;
      transition: opacity .35s ease, visibility .35s ease;
    }

    .wisp-finding-screen.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .wisp-finding-content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      max-width: 520px;
      padding: 32px;
    }

    .wisp-pulse-ring {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border: 3px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2);
      border-top-color: #22c55e;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
    }

    .wisp-finding-title {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .wisp-finding-sub {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #22c55e;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .wisp-finding-server {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #71717a;
      max-width: 440px;
      word-break: break-all;
    }

    .wisp-finding-bar-wrap {
      width: 280px;
      height: 4px;
      background: #18181b;
      border-radius: 999px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .wisp-finding-bar {
      height: 100%;
      width: 0%;
      background: #22c55e;
      transition: width 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.5);
    }

    .learning-screen {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1100;
      background: #070b12;
      transition: opacity .35s ease, visibility .35s ease;
    }

    .learning-screen iframe { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }

    .learning-screen.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .entry-notice {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 8000;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .76);
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      transition: opacity .2s ease, visibility .2s ease;
    }

    .entry-notice.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

    .entry-notice div {
      padding: 18px 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--green);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      color: var(--green);
      font: 600 16px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      box-shadow: 0 0 36px var(--green-glow);
    }

    .extension-prompt {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 24px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: min(480px, calc(100% - 32px));
      z-index: 1000;
      display: none;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--green);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
    }

    .extension-prompt.open { display: block; }

    .extension-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       FRAME AREA
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    #frameArea {
      flex: 1;
      position: relative;
      display: none;
      background: #ffffff;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #frameArea.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    .app-page {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 34px clamp(20px, 6vw, 90px) 120px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: var(--bg);
      z-index: 15;
    }

    .app-page.active { display: flex; }

    .app-page-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .settings-nav {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0 0 18px;
    }

    .settings-nav-btn {
      padding: 9px 14px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .settings-nav-btn:hover,
    .settings-nav-btn.active {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-dark);
    }

    .settings-panel { display: none; }
    .settings-panel.active { display: block; }

    .app-page-title {
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .app-page-subtitle {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .page-search {
      width: min(320px, 100%);
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      outline: none;
      padding: 10px 14px;
    }

    .page-search:focus {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--green);
    }

    .page-card {
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 18px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .page-card h3 {
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .page-card p {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .page-command-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .page-command-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 230px) 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);
    }

    .page-command-row code {
      color: var(--green);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .page-command-row span {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .page-log-list {
      max-height: 52vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .page-log-list .log-row { padding: 4px 0; }

    #browserFrames {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
    }

    .browser-tab-frame {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border: none;
      background: #ffffff;
      display: none;
    }

    .browser-tab-frame.active {
      display: block;
    }

    .frame-loader {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: #000000;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 14px;
      z-index: 25;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .frame-loader.hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .spinner {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 2px solid var(--border);
      border-top-color: var(--green);
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 0.6s linear infinite;
    }

    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }

    .frame-loader-msg {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .browser-error {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 30;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding: 24px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      color: var(--text);
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 32%, rgba(34, 197, 94, .12), transparent 50%),
        var(--bg);
    }

    .browser-error[hidden] { display: none; }

    .browser-error-card {
      width: min(520px, 100%);
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 42px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .browser-error-code {
      color: var(--green);
      font: 800 clamp(64px, 15vw, 108px)/.95 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: -.08em;
    }

    .browser-error-label {
      margin: 18px 0 8px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
      font: 700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .browser-error-title { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(22px, 5vw, 30px); }
    .browser-error-message { margin: 12px auto 0; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }
    .browser-error-url { margin: 14px 0 0; color: var(--text-dim); font: 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .browser-error-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .browser-error-actions button {
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      color: var(--text);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .browser-error-actions button:first-child { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); }
    .browser-error-actions button:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       TERMINAL COMMAND BAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .terminal-container {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: min(680px, calc(100% - 40px));
      z-index: 50;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: bottom 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
        opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    }

    /* AUTOCOMPLETE POPUP */
    .cmd-autocomplete {
      background: #111113;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      border-radius: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: none;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
      max-height: min(320px, 42vh);
      overflow-y: auto;
      scrollbar-color: var(--border-focus) transparent;
    }

    .cmd-autocomplete.visible {
      display: block;
    }

    .autocomplete-item {
      width: 100%;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      transition: background 0.1s ease;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .autocomplete-item:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .autocomplete-item:hover, .autocomplete-item.focused {
      background: var(--green-dark);
    }

    .ac-cmd {
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ac-desc {
      color: var(--text-dim);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    /* TERMINAL INPUT BOX */
    .terminal-box {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, border-radius 0.15s;
      min-height: 48px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .terminal-box:focus-within {
      border-color: var(--green);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--green), 0 0 20px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15);
    }

    .terminal-box.multiline {
      border-radius: 16px;
    }

    .terminal-prompt-prefix {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--green);
      white-space: nowrap;
      line-height: 26px;
      margin-right: 10px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    #cmdTextarea {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      outline: none;
      resize: none;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 26px;
      caret-color: var(--green);
      overflow-y: auto;
      height: 26px;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }

    #cmdTextarea::placeholder {
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .cmd-run-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-left: 8px;
      align-self: center;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .cmd-run-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-dark);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       MODALS (SETTINGS & HELP)
    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    .modal-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      z-index: 100;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .modal-backdrop.open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .modal-content {
      width: min(540px, 100%);
      background: var(--bg-panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
      max-height: 80vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .modal-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      padding-bottom: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .modal-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .modal-close-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .modal-close-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
    }

    .modal-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 10px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .modal-row-label {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .modal-row-desc {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-dim);
    }

    .modal-select {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .modal-input {
      min-width: 190px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: var(--text);
      font: 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      outline: none;
    }

    .modal-btn {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .modal-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--green);
      color: var(--green);
    }

    .modal-btn.danger:hover {
      border-color: var(--danger);
      color: var(--danger);
    }

    /* Help Commands Table */
    .cmd-list-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .cmd-list-table td {
      padding: 8px 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .cmd-name {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      color: var(--green);
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
      width: 170px;
    }

    .cmd-expl {
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* TOAST */
    .toast-pill {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 84px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
      z-index: 1000;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .toast-pill.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }

    .toast-pill.err {
      color: var(--danger);
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       INTRO OVERLAY (TYPEWRITER + BUMP + RIPPLE)
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div id="introOverlay" class="hidden">
    <canvas id="rippleCanvas"></canvas>
    <div class="intro-stage" id="introStage">
      <span class="intro-prompt" id="introPrompt">></span>
      <span class="intro-word" id="introWord"></span>
      <span class="intro-cursor" id="introCursor">_</span>
    </div>
    <div class="intro-skip-hint">Press any key or click to skip</div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       WISP AUTO-DISCOVERY FULLSCREEN SCREEN
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div id="wispFindingScreen" class="wisp-finding-screen hidden">
    <div class="wisp-finding-content">
      <div class="wisp-pulse-ring"></div>
      <h1 class="wisp-finding-title">Finding Wisp Server</h1>
      <div class="wisp-finding-sub" id="wispFindingCounter">Loading server catalog...</div>
      <div class="wisp-finding-server" id="wispFindingServer">Reading assets/backend/wisps.json...</div>
      <div class="wisp-finding-bar-wrap">
        <div class="wisp-finding-bar" id="wispFindingBar"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
       APP SHELL
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <div class="app-shell">

    <!-- LEFT SIDEBAR -->
    <aside class="sidebar">
      <div class="sidebar-header">
        <button class="search-tabs-btn" id="collapseSidebarBtn" title="Collapse sidebar">
          <span aria-hidden="true">‹</span><span class="sidebar-label">Collapse</span>
        </button>
        <label class="search-tabs-control" title="Search open tabs">
          <span class="sidebar-icon" aria-hidden="true">⌕</span>
          <input id="searchTabsInput" type="search" placeholder="Search tabs..." autocomplete="off">
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="tab-list" id="tabList"></div>

      <div class="sidebar-footer">
        <button class="new-tab-btn" id="newTabBtn"><span>+ New Tab</span><b aria-hidden="true">+</b></button>
        <div class="sidebar-actions">
          <button class="sidebar-icon-btn" id="gamesSidebarBtn" title="Games" aria-label="Games"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="4"/><path d="M6 12h4m-2-2v4"/><line x1="15" y1="11" x2="15.01" y2="11"/><line x1="18" y1="13" x2="18.01" y2="13"/></svg></button>
          <button class="sidebar-icon-btn" id="settingsBtn" title="Settings" aria-label="Settings">⚙</button>
          <button class="sidebar-icon-btn" id="cloakAboutBlankBtn" title="Launch in about:blank" aria-label="Launch in about:blank">🕶</button>
          <button class="sidebar-icon-btn" id="helpBtn" title="Help" aria-label="Help">?</button>
          <button class="sidebar-icon-btn" id="logsBtn" title="Logs" aria-label="Logs">≡</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- VIEWPORT -->
    <main class="viewport">

      <!-- TOP URL BAR: APPEARS ONLY WHEN BROWSING (HIDDEN ON NEW TAB) -->
      <header class="top-url-bar" id="topUrlBar">
        <div class="top-nav-group">
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topBackBtn" title="Back">←</button>
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topForwardBtn" title="Forward">→</button>
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topReloadBtn" title="Reload">↻</button>
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topHomeBtn" title="Home (New Tab)">⌂</button>
        </div>

        <div class="top-url-input-wrap">
          <span class="top-url-lock">🔒</span>
          <div class="search-provider" id="searchProviderControl">
            <button class="search-provider-trigger" id="searchProviderButton" type="button" aria-label="Search provider" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">S</button>
            <div class="search-provider-menu" id="searchProviderMenu" role="listbox" aria-label="Search provider" hidden></div>
            <select id="topSearchProvider" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1" hidden>
              <option value="startpage">Startpage</option>
              <option value="duckduckgo">DuckDuckGo</option>
              <option value="google">Google</option>
              <option value="bing">Bing</option>
              <option value="youtube">YouTube</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <input type="text" id="topUrlInput" placeholder="Enter URL or search query..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
          <button class="top-go-btn" id="topGoBtn">GO</button>
        </div>
        <div class="cmd-autocomplete top-command-autocomplete" id="topCommandAutocomplete"></div>

        <div class="top-nav-group">
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topBookmarkBtn" title="Bookmark this page">⭐</button>
          <button class="top-nav-btn" id="topFullscreenBtn" title="Fullscreen">⛶</button>
        </div>
      </header>

      <!-- BOOKMARKS BAR -->
      <div class="bookmarks-bar" id="bookmarksBar">
        <div id="bookmarksBarItems" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- HOME SCREEN (NEW TAB) -->
      <section id="homeScreen">
        <div class="hero-brand">
          <span class="hero-prompt">></span>SuperUser
        </div>
        <div class="hero-meta">
          By Jxo
        </div>

        <div class="system-status" aria-live="polite">
          <div class="status-chip">Server <strong id="serverPing">checking…</strong></div>
          <div class="status-chip">Time <strong id="systemTime">--:-- --</strong></div>
          <div class="status-chip">Battery <strong id="systemBattery">N/A</strong></div>
        </div>

        <div class="quick-chips">
          <div id="quickShortcuts"></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- PROXIED BROWSER FRAME -->
      <section id="frameArea">
        <div class="frame-loader" id="frameLoader">
          <div class="spinner"></div>
          <div class="frame-loader-msg" id="frameLoaderMsg">Connecting via Wisp...</div>
        </div>
        <div id="browserFrames"></div>
        <section class="browser-error" id="browserErrorScreen" aria-live="polite" hidden>
          <article class="browser-error-card">
            <div class="browser-error-code" id="browserErrorCode">404</div>
            <div class="browser-error-label" id="browserErrorLabel">Page not found</div>
            <h1 class="browser-error-title" id="browserErrorTitle">This page took a wrong turn.</h1>
            <p class="browser-error-message" id="browserErrorMessage">The site returned an error while loading this page.</p>
            <p class="browser-error-url" id="browserErrorUrl"></p>
            <div class="browser-error-actions">
              <button type="button" id="retryErrorPageBtn">Try again</button>
              <button type="button" id="homeErrorPageBtn">New tab</button>
            </div>
          </article>
        </section>
      </section>

      <section class="app-page" id="settingsPage" data-page="settings">
        <div class="app-page-header">
          <div><div class="app-page-title">Settings</div><div class="app-page-subtitle">Configure the proxy experience.</div></div>
          <input class="page-search" id="settingsSearch" data-page-search="settings" placeholder="Search settings..." autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <nav class="settings-nav" aria-label="Settings pages">
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav-btn active" data-settings-page="proxy">Proxy</button>
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav-btn" data-settings-page="personalization">Personalization</button>
          <button type="button" class="settings-nav-btn" data-settings-page="general">General</button>
        </nav>
        <section class="settings-panel active" data-settings-panel="proxy">
          <div class="page-card" data-searchable="wisp websocket server">
            <h3>Wisp WebSocket Server</h3><p>Servers are discovered automatically from the backend catalog. The last working server is tried first.</p>
            <select class="modal-select" id="wispVersionSelectPage" aria-label="Wisp protocol"><option value="auto">Protocol: Auto</option><option value="v1">Protocol: Wisp v1</option><option value="v2">Protocol: Wisp v2</option></select>
          </div>
          <div class="page-card" data-searchable="ad blocker ads performance youtube">
            <h3>Ad blocking</h3><p>Block common ad and tracking hosts before they load.</p>
            <label><input type="checkbox" id="adBlockToggle" checked> Enable fast ad blocking</label>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="settings-panel" data-settings-panel="personalization">
          <div class="page-card" data-searchable="intro animation">
            <h3>Intro Animation</h3><p>Replay the SuperUser intro animation.</p><button class="modal-btn" id="replayIntroPageBtn">Replay Intro</button>
          </div>
        </section>
        <section class="settings-panel" data-settings-panel="general">
          <div class="page-card" data-searchable="factory reset clear local storage data">
            <h3>Factory Reset</h3><p>Remove all SuperUser data saved in this browser and restore the default settings.</p>
            <button class="modal-btn danger" id="factoryResetBtn">Factory Reset</button>
          </div>
          <div class="page-card" data-searchable="service worker reset cache">
            <h3>Reset Service Worker</h3><p>Unregister and reload the proxy cache.</p><button class="modal-btn" id="resetSwPageBtn">Reset SW</button>
          </div>
        </section>
      </section>

      <section class="app-page" id="helpPage" data-page="help">
        <div class="app-page-header">
          <div><div class="app-page-title">Help</div><div class="app-page-subtitle">Commands and keyboard shortcuts.</div></div>
          <input class="page-search" data-page-search="help" placeholder="Search commands..." autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="page-card page-command-list" id="helpCommandList"></div>
      </section>

      <section class="app-page" id="logsPage" data-page="logs">
        <div class="app-page-header">
          <div><div class="app-page-title">Logs</div><div class="app-page-subtitle">Live system and proxy diagnostics.</div></div>
          <input class="page-search" data-page-search="logs" placeholder="Search logs..." autocomplete="off">
        </div>
        <div class="page-card page-log-list" id="pageLogList"></div>
        <div class="sidebar-actions"><button class="modal-btn" id="pageTestProxyBtn">Test Proxy</button><button class="modal-btn" id="pageClearLogsBtn">Clear Logs</button></div>
      </section>

      <!-- COMMAND-FIRST TERMINAL INPUT -->
      <div class="terminal-container" id="terminalContainer">
        <!-- Command menu appears when the user types sudo. -->
        <div class="cmd-autocomplete" id="cmdAutocomplete"></div>

        <div class="terminal-box" id="terminalBox">
          <span class="terminal-prompt-prefix">user@super~$</span>
          <textarea
            id="cmdTextarea"
            rows="1"
            placeholder="Enter a URL, Search the Web, or type sudo"
            autocomplete="off"
            spellcheck="false"
          ></textarea>
          <button class="cmd-run-btn" id="cmdRunBtn" title="Execute (Enter)">↵</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </main>
  </div>

  <section class="learning-screen hidden" id="learningScreen" aria-label="Super Learning">
    <iframe id="learningMockupFrame" title="Super Learning" loading="eager"></iframe>
  </section>
  <div class="entry-notice" id="entryNotice" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div>Entering >SuperUser</div>
  </div>

  <!-- SETTINGS MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-backdrop" id="settingsModal">
    <div class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-top">
        <div class="modal-title">Settings</div>
        <button class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeAllModals()">Close</button>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-row">
        <div>
          <div class="modal-row-label">Wisp WebSocket Server</div>
          <div class="modal-row-desc">Automatically discovered from the backend catalog; the last working server is tried first.</div>
        </div>
        <select class="modal-select" id="wispVersionSelect" aria-label="Wisp protocol">
          <option value="auto">Protocol: Auto</option>
          <option value="v1">Protocol: Wisp v1</option>
          <option value="v2">Protocol: Wisp v2</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-row">
        <div>
          <div class="modal-row-label">Intro Animation</div>
          <div class="modal-row-desc">Replay typewriter bump & ripple effect</div>
        </div>
        <button class="modal-btn" id="replayIntroBtn">Replay Intro</button>
      </div>

      <div class="modal-row">
        <div>
          <div class="modal-row-label">Reset Service Worker</div>
          <div class="modal-row-desc">Unregister and reload proxy cache</div>
        </div>
        <button class="modal-btn" id="resetSwBtn">Reset SW</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- HELP MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-backdrop" id="helpModal">
    <div class="modal-content">
      <div class="modal-top">
        <div class="modal-title">Commands & Shortcuts</div>
        <button class="modal-close-btn" onclick="closeAllModals()">Close</button>
      </div>

      <table class="cmd-list-table">
        <tbody>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo <url></td><td class="cmd-expl">Browse directly to any website</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo google <query></td><td class="cmd-expl">Search Google</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo yt <query></td><td class="cmd-expl">Search YouTube</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo</td><td class="cmd-expl">Show all commands</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo help</td><td class="cmd-expl">Open this commands reference</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo logs</td><td class="cmd-expl">Open system and proxy diagnostics</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo test</td><td class="cmd-expl">Run proxy connection diagnostics</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo newtab</td><td class="cmd-expl">Open a new tab</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo clear</td><td class="cmd-expl">Close all tabs and return home</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo settings</td><td class="cmd-expl">Open settings</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo reload</td><td class="cmd-expl">Reload current tab</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">sudo intro</td><td class="cmd-expl">Replay intro animation</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">Enter</td><td class="cmd-expl">Submit the command, URL, or search</td></tr>
          <tr><td class="cmd-name">Arrow keys / Tab</td><td class="cmd-expl">Choose an autocomplete command</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TOAST -->
  <div class="toast-pill" id="toastPill"></div>

  <div class="extension-prompt" id="extensionPrompt">
    <div id="extensionPromptText">A site extension is available for this page.</div>
    <div class="extension-actions">
      <button class="modal-btn" id="runExtensionBtn">Run</button>
      <button class="modal-btn" id="cancelExtensionBtn">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- CONTEXT MENU -->
  <div id="suContextMenu" style="
    position:fixed;display:none;z-index:99999;
    background:#111113;border:1px solid #27272a;border-radius:10px;
    padding:4px;min-width:180px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:13px;
  ">
    <div class="ctx-item" id="ctx-bookmark" style="padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#f4f4f5;">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>Bookmark Page
    </div>
    <div class="ctx-item" id="ctx-open2fa" style="padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#f4f4f5;">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M12 7v4"/><circle cx="12" cy="6" r="3"/></svg>Open 2FA
    </div>
    <div class="ctx-item ctx-2fa-paste" id="ctx-paste2fa" style="padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#22c55e;display:none;">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H6a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h2"/><rect x="8" y="2" width="8" height="4" rx="1"/></svg>Paste 2FA Code
    </div>
    <hr style="border:none;border-top:1px solid #27272a;margin:4px 0;">
    <div class="ctx-item" id="ctx-extensions" style="padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#f4f4f5;">
      <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20.24 12.24a6 6 0 0 0-8.49-8.49L5 10.5V19h8.5z"/><line x1="16" y1="8" x2="2" y2="22"/><line x1="17.5" y1="15" x2="9" y2="15"/></svg>Extensions

\"Reverse\", \"Flip\", \"Micro\"];\n                            let foundCount = 0;\n                            const visited = new Set();\n\n                            function clearState(obj, key) {\n                                obj[key] = \"\";\n                                if (Array.isArray(obj.ads)) obj.ads = [];\n                                if (Array.isArray(obj.hazards))              }\n\n                            function scanDeep(obj, depth = 0) {\n                                if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || depth \u003e 10 || visited.has(obj)) return;\n     const __suInlineImageAssets = Object.freeze({"assets/shortcuts/icons/chatgpt.png": "data:image/png;base64,", "assets/shortcuts/icons/discord.png": "data:image/png;base64,", "assets/shortcuts/icons/google.png": "data:image/png;base64,", "assets/shortcuts/icons/youtube.png": "data:image/png;base64,"});
    const appAsset = path => __suInlineImageAssets[path.replace(/^\/+/, '')] || appPath(path);
    const fetchAppAsset = (path, options) => {
      const key = path.replace(/^\/+/, '');
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(__suInlineTextAssets, key)) {
        return fetch(appPath(path), options);
      }
      const contentType = key.endsWith('.json') ? 'application/json; charset=utf-8' : 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8';
      return Promise.resolve(new Response(__suInlineTextAssets[key], {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': contentType }

  <script>
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     0. LIVE SYSTEM & ERROR LOGGING ENGINE
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  function addLog(msg, type = 'info') {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'log-row';

    const ts = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
      hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit', hour12: true
    });
    const tagClass = type === 'err' ? 'err' : type === 'ok' ? 'ok' : type === 'warn' ? 'warn' : 'info';
    const tagText = type === 'err' ? 'ERR' : type === 'ok' ? 'OK' : type === 'warn' ? 'WARN' : 'INFO';

    row.innerHTML = `
      <span class="log-ts">[${ts}]</span>
      <span class="log-tag ${tagClass}">[${tagText}]</span>
      <span class="log-msg">${escapeHtml(msg)}</span>
    `;

    row.dataset.searchable = msg;
    const pageLogList = document.getElementById('pageLogList');
    pageLogList?.appendChild(row);
    if (pageLogList) pageLogList.scrollTop = pageLogList.scrollHeight;
  }

  document.getElementById('pageClearLogsBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.getElementById('pageLogList').innerHTML = '';
    addLog('Logs cleared', 'info');
  });

  // Global browser error listeners
  window.addEventListener('error', (e) => {
    addLog(`${e.message} at ${e.filename || 'unknown'}:${e.lineno || 0}`, 'err');
  });

  window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => {
    const reason = e.reason ? (e.reason.message || e.reason) : 'Unknown Promise Rejection';
    addLog(`Unhandled Promise: ${reason}`, 'err');
  });

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     1. CINEMATIC TYPEWRITER + BUMP + RIPPLE INTRO
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const introOverlay = document.getElementById('introOverlay');
  const introPrompt  = document.getElementById('introPrompt');
  const introWord    = document.getElementById('introWord');
  const introCursor  = document.getElementById('introCursor');
  const rippleCanvas = document.getElementById('rippleCanvas');
  const rippleCtx    = rippleCanvas.getContext('2d');

  let introSkipped = false;
  const WORD_CHARS = [
    { c: 'S', green: true },
    { c: 'u', green: false },
    { c: 'p', green: false },
    { c: 'e', green: false },
    { c: 'r', green: false },
    { c: 'U', green: true },
    { c: 's', green: false },
    { c: 'e', green: false },
    { c: 'r', green: false }
  ];

  function resizeCanvas() {
    rippleCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    rippleCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
  resizeCanvas();

  let ripples = [];
  function triggerRipple(x, y) {
    ripples.push({
      x,
      y,
      radius: 4,
      maxRadius: Math.hypot(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight) * 1.1,
      speed: 26,
      alpha: 1.0,
      lineWidth: 16
    });

    function draw() {
      rippleCtx.clearRect(0, 0, rippleCanvas.width, rippleCanvas.height);
      let running = false;

      for (let i = 0; i < ripples.length; i++) {
        const r = ripples[i];
        if (r.alpha > 0.01) {
          running = true;
          rippleCtx.save();
          rippleCtx.beginPath();
          rippleCtx.arc(r.x, r.y, r.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          rippleCtx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34, 197, 94, ${r.alpha})`;
          rippleCtx.lineWidth = r.lineWidth;
          rippleCtx.shadowColor = '#22c55e';
          rippleCtx.shadowBlur = 24;
          rippleCtx.stroke();
          rippleCtx.restore();

          r.radius += r.speed;
          r.speed *= 1.02;
          r.alpha *= 0.94;
        }
      }

      if (running) {
        requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      } else {
        ripples = [];
        rippleCtx.clearRect(0, 0, rippleCanvas.width, rippleCanvas.height);
      }
    }
    draw();
  }

  function finishIntro() {
    if (introSkipped) return;
    introSkipped = true;
    introOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
    // Auto-launch in about:blank the first time the intro plays
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem('su_blanked')) {
      sessionStorage.setItem('su_blanked', '1');
      setTimeout(() => launchInAboutBlank(), 150);
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('cmdTextarea')?.focus();
    }, 400);
  }

  introOverlay.addEventListener('click', finishIntro);
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (!introSkipped && !introOverlay.classList.contains('hidden')) {
      finishIntro();
    }
  });

  async function playIntro() {
    introSkipped = false;
    introOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
    introWord.innerHTML = '';
    introPrompt.className = 'intro-prompt';
    introCursor.style.display = 'inline-block';

    const els = WORD_CHARS.map(item => {
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = 'intro-char' + (item.green ? ' green' : '');
      span.textContent = item.c;
      introWord.appendChild(span);
      return span;
    });

    await sleep(350);
    if (introSkipped) return;

    // Typewriter
    for (let el of els) {
      if (introSkipped) return;
      el.classList.add('typed');
      await sleep(80);
    }

    await sleep(200);
    if (introSkipped) return;
    introCursor.style.display = 'none';

    // Bump
    introPrompt.classList.add('bump-windup');
    await sleep(220);
    if (introSkipped) return;

    introPrompt.classList.add('bump-strike');
    introWord.classList.add('recoil');

    const rect = introPrompt.getBoundingClientRect();
    triggerRipple(rect.right, rect.top + rect.height / 2);

    await sleep(150);
    introWord.classList.remove('recoil');

    await sleep(350);
    finishIntro();
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     2. SCRAMJET CONTROLLER & WISP PROXY ENGINE
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  const { Controller } = $scramjetController || {};
  const { defaultConfig } = $scramjet || {};
  const EpoxyTransport = (self.EpoxyTransport && self.EpoxyTransport.default) || self.EpoxyTransport;

  const browserFrames   = document.getElementById('browserFrames');
  const frameArea       = document.getElementById('frameArea');
  const browserErrorScreen = document.getElementById('browserErrorScreen');
  const homeScreen      = document.getElementById('homeScreen');
  const topUrlBar       = document.getElementById('topUrlBar');
  const topUrlInput     = document.getElementById('topUrlInput');
  const frameLoader     = document.getElementById('frameLoader');
  const frameLoaderMsg   = document.getElementById('frameLoaderMsg');
  const learningScreen   = document.getElementById('learningScreen');
  const SCRAMJET_PREFIX  = 'eduapi/';
  const SETTINGS_KEY     = 'superuser-settings';
  const TABS_KEY         = 'superuser-tabs';
  const EXTENSIONS_KEY   = 'superuser-extensions';
  const GAMEPAD_SVG = '<svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="2" y="6" width="20" height="12" rx="4"/><path d="M6 12h4m-2-2v4"/><line x1="15" y1="11" x2="15.01" y2="11"/><line x1="18" y1="13" x2="18.01" y2="13"/></svg>';
  const SHORTCUTS_KEY    = 'superuser-shortcuts';
  const DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS = [
    { title: 'Google', url: 'https://www.google.com', domain: 'google.com' },
    { title: 'YouTube', url: 'https://www.youtube.com', domain: 'youtube.com' },
    { title: 'Discord', url: 'https://discord.com/app', domain: 'discord.com' },
    { title: 'ChatGPT', url: 'https://chatgpt.com', domain: 'chatgpt.com' },
    { title: 'Games', url: 'su://games', svg: GAMEPAD_SVG },
    { title: 'Soundboard', url: 'https://www.myinstants.com/' },
    { title: 'Extensions', url: 'su://extensions', icon: '🧩' }
  ];
  const defaultSettings  = {
    wispVersion: 'auto',
    searchProvider: 'startpage',
    adBlock: true
  };
  let settings = { ...defaultSettings };
  try { settings = { ...defaultSettings, ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY) || '{}') }; } catch (_) {}
  delete settings.wisp;
  if ('background' in settings) {
    delete settings.background;
    localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
  }
  if (settings.wispVersion === 1 || settings.wispVersion === 2 ||
      settings.wispVersion === '1' || settings.wispVersion === '2') {
    settings.wispVersion = 'auto';
  }
  if (!localStorage.getItem('superuser-default-search-startpage-v1')) {
    if (!localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY) || settings.searchProvider === 'duckduckgo') {
      settings.searchProvider = 'startpage';
      localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
    }
    localStorage.setItem('superuser-default-search-startpage-v1', 'true');
  }
  let extensionCatalog = [];
  let enabledExtensions = {};
  let visibleShortcuts = DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS;
  try { enabledExtensions = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(EXTENSIONS_KEY) || '{}'); } catch (_) {}
  // YouTube ad-blocker enabled by default
  if (!('youtube.com' in enabledExtensions)) enabledExtensions['youtube.com'] = true;
  try {
    const savedShortcuts = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SHORTCUTS_KEY) || 'null');
    if (Array.isArray(savedShortcuts)) {
      visibleShortcuts = savedShortcuts.filter(shortcut =>
        shortcut && typeof shortcut.title === 'string' && typeof shortcut.url === 'string');
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  if (!localStorage.getItem('superuser-games-shortcut-v1')) {
    const gamesShortcut = DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS.find(shortcut => shortcut.title === 'Games');
    if (gamesShortcut && !visibleShortcuts.some(shortcut => shortcut.title === gamesShortcut.title)) {
      visibleShortcuts = [...visibleShortcuts, gamesShortcut];
      localStorage.setItem(SHORTCUTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(visibleShortcuts));
    }
    localStorage.setItem('superuser-games-shortcut-v1', 'true');
  }
  if (!localStorage.getItem('superuser-shortcuts-v2')) {
    for (const title of ['Soundboard', 'Extensions']) {
      const shortcut = DEFAULT_SHORTCUTS.find(item => item.title === title);
      if (shortcut && !visibleShortcuts.some(item => item.title === title)) {
        visibleShortcuts = [...visibleShortcuts, shortcut];
      }
    }
    localStorage.setItem(SHORTCUTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(visibleShortcuts));
    localStorage.setItem('superuser-shortcuts-v2', 'true');
  }

  const AD_HOSTS = /(^|\.)((doubleclick|googlesyndication|googleadservices|adnxs|adsrvr|advertising|imasdk|adform|criteo|taboola|outbrain|scorecardresearch)\.)/i;
  const searchUrls = {
    duckduckgo: query => `https://duckduckgo.com/?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`,
    google: query => `https://www.google.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&hl=en`,
    bing: query => `https://www.bing.com/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`,
    startpage: query => `https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`,
    youtube: query => `https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
  };
  const searchProviders = [
    { id: 'startpage', name: 'Startpage', icon: 'S' },
    { id: 'duckduckgo', name: 'DuckDuckGo', icon: 'D' },
    { id: 'google', name: 'Google', icon: 'G' },
    { id: 'bing', name: 'Bing', icon: 'b' },
    { id: 'youtube', name: 'YouTube', icon: '▶' }
  ];

  function renderSearchProviderMenu() {
    const select = document.getElementById('topSearchProvider');
    const button = document.getElementById('searchProviderButton');
    const menu = document.getElementById('searchProviderMenu');
    if (!select || !button || !menu) return;
    if (!searchProviders.some(provider => provider.id === select.value)) {
      select.value = 'startpage';
    }
    const selected = searchProviders.find(provider => provider.id === select.value);
    button.textContent = selected.icon;
    button.title = selected.name;
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', `Search provider: ${selected.name}`);
    menu.innerHTML = searchProviders.map(provider => `
      <button class="search-provider-option" type="button" role="option"
        aria-checked="${provider.id === select.value}" data-search-provider="${provider.id}">
        <span class="search-provider-icon" aria-hidden="true">${provider.icon}</span>
        <span>${provider.name}</span>
      </button>`).join('');
    menu.querySelectorAll('[data-search-provider]').forEach(option => {
      option.addEventListener('click', () => {
        select.value = option.dataset.searchProvider;
        select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        menu.hidden = true;
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        renderSearchProviderMenu();
      });
    });
  }

  let scramjet = null;
  let activeTransport = null;
  let sjFrame  = null;
  let isProxyReady = false;
  let allowApplicationUnload = false;

  const WISP_STORAGE_KEY = 'superuser_wisp_working';

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     WISP TRANSPORT — optimized, Chrome-mimic, 429-resilient
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  // Opium IC header order (Chrome navigation fingerprint)
  const CHROME_HEADER_ORDER = [
    'sec-ch-ua','sec-ch-ua-mobile','sec-ch-ua-platform',
    'upgrade-insecure-requests','user-agent','accept','origin',
    'sec-fetch-site','sec-fetch-mode','sec-fetch-user','sec-fetch-dest',
    'referer','accept-encoding','accept-language','priority',
    'content-type','content-length','cookie'
  ];
  // Opium BC — strip expensive client-hint headers to reduce fingerprint surface
  const STRIP_HEADERS = new Set([
    'sec-ch-ua-arch','sec-ch-ua-bitness','sec-ch-ua-full-version',
    'sec-ch-ua-full-version-list','sec-ch-ua-model',
    'sec-ch-ua-platform-version','sec-ch-ua-wow64','sec-ch-ua-form-factors'
  ]);

  // Normalize + reorder headers the same way Opium's QC() does
  function mimicChromeHeaders(headers = {}, method = 'GET', referrer = '', mode = 'navigate') {
    const h = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(headers)) {
      if (!STRIP_HEADERS.has(k.toLowerCase())) h[k.toLowerCase()] = v;
    }
    h['user-agent'] ||= navigator.userAgent;
    h['accept-encoding'] ||= 'gzip, deflate, br';
    h['accept-language'] ||= 'en-US,en;q=0.9';
    h['priority'] ||= 'u=0, i';
    if (referrer) h['referer'] = referrer;
    if (mode === 'navigate') {
      h['sec-fetch-site'] ||= 'none';
      h['sec-fetch-dest'] ||= 'document';
      h['sec-fetch-user'] ||= '?1';
      if (method === 'GET') delete h['origin'];
    } else {
      h['sec-fetch-site'] ||= 'same-origin';
      h['sec-fetch-dest'] ||= 'empty';
    }
    // Re-emit in IC order, then any extras not in the list
    const ordered = {};
    for (const k of CHROME_HEADER_ORDER) { if (k in h) ordered[k] = h[k]; }
    for (const k of Object.keys(h)) { if (!(k in ordered)) ordered[k] = h[k]; }
    return ordered;
  }

  function getWispUrl() {
    return localStorage.getItem(WISP_STORAGE_KEY) || 'Auto-discovery';
  }

  function getWispVersion(wispUrl) {
    if (settings.wispVersion === 'v1') return 1;
    if (settings.wispVersion === 'v2') return 2;
    return 1;
  }

  // Probe transport — returns status code, throws on error/429
  async function probeTransport(transport, timeoutMs = 10000) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    try {
      const probeHeaders = mimicChromeHeaders({
        'accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
        'sec-fetch-mode': 'navigate'
      }, 'GET', '', 'navigate');
      const response = await transport.request(
        new URL('https://example.com/'),
        'GET',
        null,
        Object.entries(probeHeaders),
        controller.signal
      );
      if (response.body && typeof response.body.cancel === 'function') {
        await response.body.cancel();
      }
      return response.status;
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
    }
  }

  // Connect to a single Wisp URL — fast path, no probe overhead
  async function attemptConnectWisp(wispUrl, timeoutMs = 10000) {
    if (!EpoxyTransport) return null;
    const timer = { id: null };
    let transport = null;
    const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => {
      timer.id = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), timeoutMs);
    });
    try {
      const v = getWispVersion(wispUrl);
      transport = new EpoxyTransport({
        wisp: wispUrl,
        wisp_v2: v === 2,
        wisp_ws_protocols: v === 2 ? ['wisp-v2'] : [],
        // Minimal WS — arraybuffer reduces GC pressure vs Blob
        ws_binaryType: 'arraybuffer'
      });
      await Promise.race([transport.init(), timeoutPromise]);
      const status = await Promise.race([probeTransport(transport, timeoutMs), timeoutPromise]);
      clearTimeout(timer.id);
      // 429 = rate-limited but server is alive — treat as reachable with penalty flag
      if (status === 429) return { transport, url: wispUrl, rateLimited: true };
      if (status >= 200 && status < 400) return { transport, url: wispUrl, rateLimited: false };
      transport.close?.();
      return null;
    } catch (_) {
      clearTimeout(timer.id);
      transport?.close?.();
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function discoverAndConnectWisp() {
    const screen    = document.getElementById('wispFindingScreen');
    const counterEl = document.getElementById('wispFindingCounter');
    const serverEl  = document.getElementById('wispFindingServer');
    const barEl     = document.getElementById('wispFindingBar');

    const ui = (counter, server, barPct) => {
      if (counterEl) counterEl.textContent = counter;
      if (serverEl)  serverEl.textContent  = server;
      if (barEl)     barEl.style.width     = `${barPct}%`;
    };

    const savedUrl = localStorage.getItem(WISP_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (savedUrl?.startsWith('ws')) {
      ui('Checking last working server…', savedUrl, 5);
      addLog(`Checking last working Wisp server (10s timeout): ${savedUrl}`, 'info');
      const savedResult = await attemptConnectWisp(savedUrl, 10000);
      if (savedResult && !savedResult.rateLimited) {
        addLog(`Verified saved Wisp: ${savedUrl}`, 'ok');
        screen?.classList.add('hidden');
        return savedResult;
      }
      savedResult?.transport.close?.();
      addLog('Last working Wisp server did not respond within 10 seconds; starting discovery.', 'warn');
      localStorage.removeItem(WISP_STORAGE_KEY);
    }

    screen?.classList.remove('hidden');
    let retryAttempt = 0;
    while (true) {
      retryAttempt++;
      ui('Loading server catalog…', 'Reading assets/backend/wisps.json…', 0);

      try {
        const catalogResponse = await fetchAppAsset('assets/backend/wisps.json', {
          cache: 'no-store'
        });
        if (!catalogResponse.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Catalog request failed with HTTP ${catalogResponse.status}`);
        }
        const catalog = await catalogResponse.json();
        if (!Array.isArray(catalog) || catalog.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('The Wisp catalog is empty or invalid');
        }

        const allServers = [];
        const groupLabels = {
          Offical: 'Official',
          Onyx: 'Official Backup',
          Opium: 'Mirror 2'
        };
        for (const entry of catalog) {
          if (!entry || typeof entry.name !== 'string' || typeof entry.path !== 'string') {
            throw new Error('The Wisp catalog contains an invalid entry');
          }
          const cleanPath = entry.path.replace(/^\/+/, '');
          if (!cleanPath || cleanPath.split('/').includes('..')) {
            throw new Error(`The Wisp catalog contains an invalid list path for ${entry.name}`);
          }
          const response = await fetchAppAsset(`assets/backend/${cleanPath}`, {
            cache: 'no-store'
          });
          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`Could not load ${entry.name} servers (HTTP ${response.status})`);
          }
          const urls = await response.json();
          if (!Array.isArray(urls)) {
            throw new Error(`${entry.name} server list is not an array`);
          }
          for (const url of urls) {
            if (typeof url !== 'string' || !/^wss?:\/\//i.test(url)) {
              throw new Error(`${entry.name} server list contains an invalid endpoint`);
            }
            allServers.push({
              group: groupLabels[entry.name] || entry.name,
              url
            });
          }
        }

        if (allServers.length === 0) {
          throw new Error('No Wisp endpoints were found in the configured server lists');
        }

        const total = allServers.length;
        addLog(`Probing all ${total} configured Wisp servers...`, 'info');
        for (let index = 0; index < total; index++) {
          const server = allServers[index];
          const current = index + 1;
          const percent = Math.round((current / total) * 95);
          ui(`Checking ${current}/${total}`, `${server.group}: ${server.url}`, percent);
          addLog(`[${current}/${total}] Checking ${server.group}: ${server.url}`, 'info');

          const result = await attemptConnectWisp(server.url, 10000);
          if (!result || result.rateLimited) {
            if (result?.rateLimited) {
              result.transport.close?.();
              addLog(`${server.url} returned HTTP 429; checking the next server.`, 'warn');
            }
            continue;
          }

          localStorage.setItem(WISP_STORAGE_KEY, server.url);
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
          } catch (error) {
            addLog(`Could not persist Wisp settings: ${error.message}`, 'warn');
          }
          ui(`Connected (${current}/${total})`, `${server.group}: ${server.url}`, 100);
          addLog(`Connected to ${server.group}: ${server.url}`, 'ok');
          await sleep(300);
          screen?.classList.add('hidden');
          return result;
        }
